events.body:
## Outcome

Keep repositories and collaboration usable on unreliable links by syncing only the requested data and resuming verified transfer work.

## Implementation

- Add full, default-branch, collaboration-only, blobless, and metadata-first sync profiles.
- Allow large objects, release assets, non-default branches, and history beyond a depth boundary to be deferred independently.
- Apply per-node upload and download caps with a token bucket shared by Git, collaboration, and artifact transfer.
- Persist verified chunk or object checkpoints so interrupted transfers resume without retransmitting completed work.
- Show estimated, completed, deferred, and remaining bytes plus an exact explanation of unavailable content.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every profile advertises only content it can actually serve.
- Resumption verifies prior bytes and rejects mismatched checkpoints.
- Collaboration-only sync transfers no Git blob or release-asset payload.
- Changing profiles fetches the minimal missing data without rebuilding existing verified state.
- Bandwidth limits remain within a deterministic tolerance in tests.

## Dependencies

Uses Git probes from #435, offline manifests from #441, and the large-object path in #467.

## Verification

Interrupt every profile at multiple byte boundaries, resume it, change profiles, corrupt a checkpoint, and verify object identifiers, advertised coverage, byte accounting, and rate bounds.
events.title: Add selective low-bandwidth sync and resumable transfer
